note: Recorded reference values, NOT a gate (ADR 0041, which supersedes ADR 0018). idleRssMiB is the idle RSS of the Docker image's main process 10 s after start with no channels, from the v1.0 release measurement (111.3 / 110.7 / 111.3 MiB); CI reports the current value against it in the job summary and never fails on it. channelIncrementMiB.wechat is a recorded reference (the v1.0 measurement was +12.5 MiB; the old cap was 25), also report-only. Update on each release if you like; no reason is required.
